import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Cron } from '@nestjs/schedule';

@Injectable()
export class DeletesInlineTask {
  constructor(private readonly prisma: any, private readonly jobs: any) {}

  @Cron('0 4 * * *')
  async tick(): Promise<void> {
    await this.jobs.enqueue('housekeeping.deletes-inline');
    await this.prisma.session.deleteMany({ where: { expired: true } });
  }
}
